en: The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a cluster of long, single-story buildings with gabled roofs, set against a backdrop of dense tropical forest and hills. There is a tree in the foreground, some steps and retaining walls, and a few people can be seen near the buildings. The postcard has a caption in Portuguese at the top, and an editor's credit along the right edge.
